title: Принять private RC и выпустить non-authorizing G-RELEASE decision packet
summary: Зафиксировать техническое принятие exact private RC и сформировать immutable decision packet, по которому owner позже может разрешить или отклонить конкретную public release branch.
why: Private fitness and public authority answer different questions. A green dossier must not create a tag, registry upload, legal identity or credential grant by implication. `RAG:✅` permanence/channel facts в `@plan/knowledge/research-P10-design-rag.json`.

include: Independent dossier verification; private acceptance record; exact subject/checksum/SBOM/provenance/source/tree binding; release notes; final DoD; public eligibility blockers; proposed identities/channels/version/tag/actions; credential/capability prerequisites; rollback/revocation limits; packet digest and expiry/invalidation triggers; offline verifier and negative fixtures.
exclude: Accepting/superseding D5 on the owner's behalf; minting `[OWNER-GATE:G-RELEASE]`; changing `LICENSE`, visibility or package identity; resolving Dart MCP path dependency; creating/pushing tag; Packagist/pub.dev/GitHub release; credentials/OIDC; modifying repository settings; claiming deletion/rollback of a published version.

reads.why: Source input; exact context is preserved in item sections.

rules: Private acceptance is a technical record bound to one source tree and exact subject digests; any relevant byte, receipt, risk or capability change invalidates it. G-RELEASE packet is a request, never a grant. It must list a finite branch per public action with exact registry/repository identity, version/tag, subject digests, legal/support decision reference, credential path, preconditions, compensating response and irreversibility warning. Unknown identity/channel/version, unresolved D5, proprietary/public mismatch, `publish_to: none`, MCP path dependency or absent capability leaves public eligibility false without making private acceptance red. A future grant must cite the packet digest and cannot widen it. Public execution requires a separate exact owner invocation; P10 performs none.
guidance: Verify acceptance and request as separate schemas/objects. The verifier must reject `authorized=true` without owner evidence, wildcard channels/actions, mutable subject identity, stale dossier, missing public blocker and any command transcript showing tag/upload/release. Record inability to delete or rewrite published versions as a release consequence, not a promised rollback.

validation.expect: Source acceptance condition preserved in Validation section.

deliverables: Digest-bound accepted private-RC record, final release notes/DoD, explicit public blocker set and immutable non-authorizing G-RELEASE decision packet for optional future owner scope.

result.notes:
WPA-02 repair: private acceptance GREEN; public eligibility RED; G-RELEASE request remains non-authorizing and no release action executed. Recovered terminal receipt with deterministic run identity.
